original_commits.author: Timothy Schmidt
original_commits.message:
dt-bindings: media: i2c: Add Sony IMX179

The IMX179 is an 8 MP CMOS sensor with four MIPI CSI-2 data lanes, used
as the rear camera of the LG Fx0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

original_commits.author: Timothy Schmidt
original_commits.message:
media: i2c: Add Sony IMX179 driver

Add a V4L2 driver for the Sony IMX179 with one full-resolution 3280x2464
RAW10 mode on four lanes at 30 frames/s from a 24 MHz clock (648 Mbit/s
per lane). The register sequence follows NVIDIA's GPLv2 Tegra imx179.c.
It provides exposure, analogue gain, vertical blanking and the SMIA test
pattern controls.

The Bayer order (RGGB) and the analogue gain mapping are assumptions
until checked on hardware. Build-tested only.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

original_commits.author: Timothy Schmidt
original_commits.message:
media: i2c: imx179: Report the crop rectangles

libcamera reads the pixel array and crop rectangles through the
selection API and falls back to defaults with errors when the sensor
has none. The driver's only mode reads out the whole 3280x2464 active
array, so report that for the crop, crop default, crop bounds and native
size targets.

This patch was prepared with the help of an AI coding assistant; the
change was reviewed and tested on hardware by the submitter.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5 checkpatch

original_commits.author: Timothy Schmidt
original_commits.message:
media: i2c: imx179: Add a 2x2 binned 1640x1232 mode

The driver offers only the full 3280x2464 readout. Software ISPs such
as libcamera's soft ISP then process about one frame per second on
small SoCs, which makes the auto-exposure loop slow and the preview
unusable.

Add a 1640x1232 mode that bins the whole array 2x2, as the original
Android system's preview mode does. It keeps the PLL, lane and timing
settings and the full-resolution minimum frame length, so it also runs
at about 30 frames/s. Split the register list into common settings and
the per-mode output size and binning, track the active mode, and derive
the vblank and exposure ranges from its height.

This patch was prepared with the help of an AI coding assistant; the
change was reviewed and tested on hardware by the submitter.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5 checkpatch

original_commits.author: Timothy Schmidt
original_commits.message:
media: i2c: Add Sony IMX132 driver

Add a V4L2 subdevice driver for the Sony IMX132, the front camera of
the LG Fx0. It supports one 1976x1200 RAW10 mode on a single CSI-2 lane
with exposure, analogue gain, vertical blanking and test pattern
controls, and runtime PM.

The register sequence follows NVIDIA's GPLv2 Tegra imx132.c. The lane
selection (0x3301) and the VT divider that depends on the lane count
(0x30a4) follow the AtomISP imx driver, whose clock code also gives the
pixel rate: 24 MHz / 2 * 33 = 396 Mbit/s on one lane, 39.6 Mpixel/s.

This patch was prepared with the help of an AI coding assistant; the
change was reviewed and tested on hardware by the submitter.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5 checkpatch
